bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
test "$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service)" = active || exit 70
test "$(docker inspect deploy-gaybbs-1 --format '{{.State.Running}}')" = true || exit 71
db=deploy-postgres-1
before_pg=$(docker inspect "$db" --format '{{.Id}}')
sql="WITH eligible AS (
 SELECT q.edit_id FROM room_status_message_edits q
 JOIN room_source_events e ON e.event_id=q.room_event_id
 JOIN room_posts r ON r.room_id=e.room_id
 JOIN posting_deliveries d ON d.delivery_id=q.delivery_id
 JOIN posting_topics t ON t.topic_id=d.posting_topic_id
 WHERE q.state='needs_reconcile'
  AND e.kind='finished' AND e.state='applied' AND r.status='finished'
  AND d.status='sent' AND d.telegram_message_id IS NOT NULL AND d.rendered_text IS NOT NULL
  AND t.enabled=TRUE AND t.purpose IN ('room','announcement')
  AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM room_status_message_edits active
   WHERE active.delivery_id=q.delivery_id AND active.state='sending')
  AND (SELECT count(DISTINCT feature) FROM gaybbs_feature_release_gates
    WHERE feature IN ('room','announcement') AND enabled=TRUE
    AND length(source_commit)=40 AND length(trim(ci_evidence))>0
    AND length(trim(gserver_runtime_evidence))>0
    AND length(trim(telegram_e2e_evidence))>0)=2
 ORDER BY q.edit_id LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE OF q SKIP LOCKED
)
UPDATE room_status_message_edits q SET state='pending',updated_at=NOW()
FROM eligible x WHERE q.edit_id=x.edit_id
RETURNING 'ONE_TERMINAL_REPAIR_QUEUED';"
result=$(docker exec "$db" psql -X -U gace -d gaybbs -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -At -c "$sql") || exit 72
printf '%s\n' "$result" | grep -qx ONE_TERMINAL_REPAIR_QUEUED || exit 73
echo CONTROLLED_TERMINAL_REPAIR_QUEUED=ONE
sleep 35
finished=$(docker exec "$db" psql -X -U gace -d gaybbs -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -At -c "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM room_status_message_edits q JOIN room_source_events e ON e.event_id=q.room_event_id WHERE e.kind='finished' AND q.state='confirmed'") || exit 74
echo TERMINAL_CONFIRMED_COUNT="$finished"
docker exec "$db" psql -X -U gace -d gaybbs -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -At -F '|' -c "SELECT e.kind,q.state,count(*) FROM room_status_message_edits q JOIN room_source_events e ON e.event_id=q.room_event_id GROUP BY e.kind,q.state ORDER BY e.kind,q.state" || exit 75
test "$(docker inspect "$db" --format '{{.Id}}')" = "$before_pg" || exit 76
test "$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service)" = active || exit 77
test "$finished" = 3 || exit 78
echo PUBLIC_TERMINAL_ONE_TIME_RECONCILE_PASS
